featurebullets: About this item Space-Saving Over-the-Range Design: Maximize kitchen space with this 30-inch microwave that mounts above your stove. This microwave hood vent combo combines cooking and ventilation in one appliance. Measures: 16.12" H x 29.87" W x 15.56" D Trusted GE Performance: From quick breakfasts to late-night snacks, this GE over-the-range microwave delivers the reliable performance, user-friendly controls, and everyday convenience that have made GE a trusted name in kitchens for generations Powerful 2-Speed Ventilation: Keep small spaces clear of cooking odors, steam and smoke with a 300-CFM ventilation system and 2-speed fan Charcoal Filter: Enjoy cooking and cleaner air, too. The replaceable charcoal filter removes fumes and odors that are released from foods during cooking Simple One-Touch Controls: One-touch express cooking settings and 4 convenience cook settings provide easy operation for busy lifestyles, while the digital display and electronic keypad provide precise control of cook time and power settings Turntable On/Off: Enjoy versatile cooking with the turntable on/off feature, perfect for evenly heating larger or oddly shaped dishes 10 Power Levels: Provides a variety of power levels to accommodate all cooking needs Child Lock for Added Peace of Mind: This over-the-range microwave oven with child lock helps add confidence for families and shared spaces. desc: Upgrade your kitchen with the GE 30-Inch Over-the-Range Microwave Oven, a 1.6 cu ft microwave that combines powerful cooking and built-in ventilation in one space-saving appliance. This over the range microwave, above stove microwave, and microwave hood vent combo mounts above your cooktop to free valuable counter space while delivering 1000 watts of cooking power and 10 power levels for everyday meals. The microwave with exhaust fan features 300 CFM recirculating ventilation, a 2-speed fan, and a replaceable charcoal filter to help reduce smoke, steam, cooking odors, and fumes. Prepare meals with confidence using one-touch express cooking, 4 convenience cook settings, auto defrost, a digital display, and electronic touch controls for precise operation. The removable 12.8-inch glass turntable promotes even heating, while the Child Lock adds confidence for families and shared spaces. Perfect for apartments, condos, and modern kitchens, this 30 inch microwave, microwave over stove, microwave above range, and over stove microwave with vent delivers the trusted performance and everyday convenience you expect from GE.
